notes:
ACCESS: Shopify storefront, reached by plain direct curl_cffi fetches through probe.fetch (profile chrome124) - no proxy, no 403, no 429, matching the route the prior Furniture and Home-Decor passes on this SR recorded. robots.txt is Shopify's standard file and names NO Anthropic/Claude/ClaudeBot agent; its 'User-agent: *' block disallows only /admin, /cart, /carts, /checkout, /checkouts/, /orders, /account, /a/downloads/-/* and faceted /collections/*+* multi-tag URLs. I fetched no disallowed path - only the homepage, the four sitemaps, one collection page and one /collections/<handle>/products.json. Shopify's header note that checkouts are for humans is irrelevant here; nothing transactional was touched. No Crawl-delay is declared; probe.py's 2s per-host gap was left in force.

WHAT I CHECKED, AND WHY THE ABSENCE IS CONFIRMED. Four independent sources, all negative:

(1) MEGA-MENU. The homepage server-renders Blu Dot's complete three-tier navigation (header__main-nav-item / mega-menu__tier-2-list-item / mega-menu__tier-3-list-item). I enumerated all 10 top-level items and every tier-2 and tier-3 node under them: Living, Dining, Bedroom, Office, Outdoor, Lighting, Decor, In Stock + Ready to Ship, Sale, Discover. There is NO Bath or Bathroom department, and no bathroom node hides inside any of the seven product departments - tier 3 is the deepest level and I read every one of its ~70 entries. The whole of Decor is Candles + Candle Holders, Vases/Trays/Bowls, Art, Mirrors, Rugs, Pillows + Throws, Outdoor Pillows, Coat Racks + Hooks, Storage Baskets, Office Accessories.

(2) COLLECTION SITEMAP. https://www.bludot.com/sitemap_collections_1.xml lists 423 collections - i.e. every PLP the storefront publishes, including ones the menu does not surface. Regexing all 423 for bath|shower|toilet|vanity|mirror|towel|sink|basin|soap returns exactly ONE URL, /collections/mirrors, and nothing else. There is no bath, bathroom, bath-storage, bath-accessories, vanity or powder-room collection at any depth.

(3) PRODUCT SITEMAPS. sitemap_products_1.xml (1001 URLs) + sitemap_products_2.xml (519 URLs) = Blu Dot's entire 1,520-product catalogue. Regexing every product URL for bath|shower|toilet|vanity|towel|sink|basin|soap|hamper returns ZERO hits. Blu Dot sells no bathroom product of any kind - no sanitaryware, baths, showers, enclosures, taps, basins, bathroom cabinets, vanity units, bathroom storage, bath accessories or bathroom hardware.

(4) PAGES SITEMAP + RAW HOMEPAGE. sitemap_pages_1.xml (155 URLs) contains no bath/shower/toilet/vanity page, and the string 'bath' does not occur even once anywhere in the rendered homepage HTML (0 matches, case-insensitive).

MIRRORS - checked explicitly, rule 10 says the word must never cause a skip, and rule 29 says it must be disambiguated rather than keyword-matched. /collections/mirrors holds 12 products, read from the storefront's own /collections/mirrors/products.json?limit=250: Glance Mirror, Mode Large/Small Mirror, Mirror Mirror - Large, Hoopla Mirror, Hoopla Large Mirror, Hang 1 Large Square/Square/Large Swoval/Capsule/Round Mirror, TDH Leaning Mirror. Every one carries product_type 'Mirrors' and Shopify tags of Bedroom, Dining, 'Decor + Accessories' and 'Decor + Lighting'. Not one carries a Bath, Bathroom or Vanity tag, and the collection is reached in the menu only via Decor > Home Decor > Mirrors and the Living/Dining/Bedroom Decor + Accessories blocks. These are decorative wall and leaning mirrors, with no bathroom, vanity, LED, illuminated, demister or cabinet-mirror variant and no bathroom hierarchy anywhere above them - so by PRIMARY PRODUCT FUNCTION + WEBSITE HIERARCHY they are Decor/Wall Decor, not Bathroom, and no row was created.

ALSO CHECKED AND NEGATIVE: /collections/storage-baskets and /collections/organization (general home organization under Decor > Home Organization, no bathroom framing - rule 30-33 keeps them in Storage); /collections/coat-racks-hooks (entryway coat hooks under Living > Entryway and Decor > Home Organization, not bathroom/robe hooks); /collections/trays and /collections/vases-trays-catchalls (Dining and Decor tray/catchall assortments, no vanity-tray or bathroom framing); /collections/bedroom-closet-storage (closet, not bath). Blu Dot's Lighting department has no bathroom, vanity or mirror-light node, so nothing was routed to Lighting either.

CONCLUSION: this is a genuine, verified absence, not an access failure - every page fetched returned HTTP 200. Status NO BATHROOM FOUND with zero rows, per rule 36. No row was fabricated.
